Let \(z=x+iy\). The first equation is a circle:
\[
(x-25)^2+(y-20)^2=25.
\]
The second equation gives the perpendicular bisector of the points \(4+k\) and \(k+3i\):
\[
|z-(4+k)|=|z-(k+3i)|.
\]
Squaring and simplifying:
\[
(x-(k+4))^2+y^2=(x-k)^2+(y-3)^2
\]
\[
8x-6y=8k+7.
\]
So the system has exactly one solution exactly when this line is tangent to the circle centered at \((25,20)\) with radius \(5\). The distance from \((25,20)\) to the line \(8x-6y-(8k+7)=0\) is
\[
\frac{|8(25)-6(20)-(8k+7)|}{\sqrt{8^2+(-6)^2}}
=
\frac{|73-8k|}{10}.
\]
Set this equal to \(5\):
\[
|73-8k|=50.
\]
Thus
\[
73-8k=50 \quad \text{or} \quad 73-8k=-50,
\]
giving
\[
k=\frac{23}{8} \quad \text{or} \quad k=\frac{123}{8}.
\]
Their sum is
\[
\frac{23}{8}+\frac{123}{8}=\frac{146}{8}=\frac{73}{4}.
\]
So \(m=73,\ n=4\), and
\[
m+n=77.
\]

ANSWER: 77
